newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids down as MGE slips.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids down as MGE slips.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat bids slipped on Thursday as MGE futures retraced somewhat and farmer selling was sporadic as some tried to take advantage of Wednesday's gains while others held out for higher prices.
"Farmers are starting to show a little interest," a Montana dealer said. "When we closed lower today, everybody and their uncle was trying to sell wheat."

But in other areas, movement remained sluggish as farmers waited for some indication of where the market was going. One Minnesota dealer said the late break in futures might attract some panic selling as farmers wonder if prices have peaked.
"There wasn't much in the way of country movement today but maybe with the way we closed, we'll shake some wheat loose tomorrow," he said.
MGE December spring wheat futures closed at $4.13-1/4 per bushel, down 3-3/4 cents from Wednesday's strong close.
